mapper.select: SELECT template_id FROM report_template WHERE template_code = #{templateCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_report WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT product_id FROM product_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT t.template_id AS templateId, t.template_code AS templateCode, t.template_name AS templateName, t.template_version AS templateVersion, t.customer_code AS customerCode, t.report_type AS reportType, t.module_code AS moduleCode, t.report_name AS reportName, t.template_path AS templatePath, t.template_sha256 AS templateSha256, t.status AS status FROM product_template pt JOIN report_template t ON t.template_id = pt.template_id AND t.del_flag = '0' WHERE pt.product_id = #{productId} AND pt.del_flag = '0' AND pt.enabled = 1 AND t.status = 'active' ORDER BY pt.is_default DESC, pt.sort_order, t.template_id
SELECT id FROM product_config WHERE del_flag = '0' AND (product_bio = #{name} OR product_name = #{name} OR product_code = #{name}) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS id, product_bio AS productBio, product_name AS productName, product_code AS productCode, status AS status FROM product_config WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS id, project_no AS projectNo, project_name AS projectName, customer AS customer FROM project_config WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY project_no, id

SELECT id AS id, project_no AS projectNo, project_name AS projectName FROM project_config WHERE del_flag = '0' AND id IN
#{pid}
mapper.update: UPDATE product_template SET del_flag = '1', update_time = NOW() WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_template (product_id, template_id, is_default, enabled, sort_order, create_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{templateId}, 0, 1, #{sortOrder}, NOW())
